correctness.rationale: A 3-limited packing is exactly a cyclic binary word of length n>=5 whose every five-consecutive-bit sum is <=3. The 16-state four-bit de Bruijn transfer matrix gives a bijection to all closed walks and weighs each by the total window deficit 3n-5k. The exact polynomial identity det(I-tM)=1-tu^3-t^2u-t^4u^2-2t^5+t^7u+t^10 is rigorously certified by 833 integer evaluations and explicit bidegree interpolation bounds, checked by the embedded standalone program. Logarithmic differentiation yields the stated N/D generating function. The first five deficit coefficients are calculated symbolically in RESULT.md, proving all five optimizer counts and sharp size floor(3n/5). Direct C++ enumeration (n=5..18) and independent Python recurrence (n=5..80) agree and test boundaries including n=5. No infinite assertion rests solely on finite sampling.

originality.rationale: The claim is an explicit entire cardinality enumerator and five residue-class maximum-set census for closed-neighborhood capacity-three packings of squared cycles. The 2023 motivating limited-packing partition paper addresses different invariants and predominantly capacity two, while the 2024 product/total-limited paper treats predominantly open-neighborhood and capacity-two product cases. Full-text checks of the relevant statements, complement-to-double-domination searches, and published research-record comparisons located no result implying the exact rational denominator or five optimizer multiplicities. Priority remains provisional; the absence of indexed coverage alone is not a proof of originality.
residual_risks: Some exact double-domination or cyclic-word enumeration may be unindexed or inaccessible under the searched terminology.
Two mathematically adjacent published records were only available as short result summaries, not inspected in full.

value.rationale: This solves an exact infinite-family local-capacity placement problem on a natural highly symmetric graph, refining a scalar LP bound into all labelled cardinality coefficients and a distinctive five-class optimal-multiplicity law. The degree-ten rational denominator, the constant ten max-set count at n divisible by five and the polynomial counts in other congruence classes give compact reproducible structural benchmarks for both 3-limited packing and its double-domination complement. It is not a generic renaming of a standard exercise, a fixed-order census or a routine single-parameter increment.
